content.text: I will run a short read-only awk command to count unique stock indices Bob sold but never bought.

arguments: {"script":"awk 'tolower($0) ~ /bob/ { if (tolower($0) ~ /(sell|sold)/) a[$(NF-1)]=1; if (tolower($0) ~ /(buy|bought)/) b[$(NF-1)]=1 } END{c=0; for(i in a) if(!(i in b)) c++; print c}' /usr/stock.log"}
